# connectracer_bedrockagentcore_gateway (Data Source)

Looks up an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway by name.

This data source can be used to retrieve gateway details (ID, URL, ARN) without creating a circular dependency when the gateway needs to reference itself.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the gateway to look up.

### Read-Only

- `authorizer_type` (String) The authorizer type of the gateway.
- `description` (String) The description of the gateway.
- `gateway_arn` (String) The ARN of the gateway.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway.
- `gateway_url` (String) The URL of the gateway.
- `protocol_type` (String) The protocol type of the gateway.
- `status` (String) The status of the gateway.
